Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

Unlike the fractious, often indolent @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, Sabbat Brujah are fervent supporters of their sect, channeling their clan's revolutionary fire directly into the Sword of Caine's cause. They favor direct, hands-on action over political maneuvering, throwing themselves into brawls and raids rather than backroom influence games.

Disciplines: Celerity, Potence, Presence

Advantage: Rather than gaining bonus Influence as some clans do, Sabbat Brujah may select a second Ability free of cost during character creation from Politics, Academics, Brawl, or Streetwise (in any combination), reflecting their preference for getting things done the hard way.

Disadvantage: The clan's infamous temper persists undiminished in the antitribu; Brujah suffer a one-Trait penalty on Self-Control/Instinct tests relating to anger or passion.

Organization: Sabbat Brujah cluster informally around packs and causes that let them act on their convictions, providing much of the muscle and zeal that drives the sect's crusades.
